entities.summary: Anthony Salvatore Castonzo is an American former professional football offensive tackle who played in the National Football League (NFL) for ten seasons with the Indianapolis Colts. After a college career at Boston College, Castonzo was selected by the Colts with their first round draft pick in the 2011 NFL draft.
